decision.scope: Finite local developmental speaker-conditioned generation, anonymous aggregate reporting, no identification or presentation as an actual participant, no participant-level public release.
decision.reasoning: The authors prohibit impersonation but explicitly demonstrate persona-conditioned dialogue generation. These provisions support a distinction between bounded non-deceptive research and deploying an identifiable participant replica. Pseudonymization alone is not permission for impersonation. This is an evidence-based scope interpretation, not a finding that every downstream use is lawful.
decision.authority_boundary: This review grants no execution allocation and does not extend the previous 64-request pilot amendment. A new prospective batch still needs its own registration, effective authorization, privacy checks, model verification, budget check and RAM preflight.

corpus_paper.citation: Yamashita, Inoue, Guo, Mochizuki, Kawahara and Higashinaka. 2023. RealPersonaChat: A Realistic Persona Chat Corpus with Interlocutors' Own Personalities. PACLIC 37, pp. 852-861.
corpus_paper.read_scope: Full ten-page paper, with particular attention to sections 3, 5, 7 and ethics discussion.
corpus_paper.findings: The paper reports Nagoya University ethics approval and prior participant agreement to copyright waiver and public release. Original consent documents were not independently inspected; this is author-reported provenance, not approval of PersonaSLM or consent to replicas. Participants were told to avoid identifying information. Dialogue collection imposed an approximate 50-character utterance ceiling and minimum 30 turns. Thus brevity is partly corpus-imposed and must not automatically count as speaker-specific style. Natural dialogue also contains substantially less explicit persona information than the fictional comparator.
corpus_paper.prospective_implication: Include a generic brevity baseline, distinguish speaker identification from generative fidelity, and keep all participant-level materials local. No personality or demographic prediction is proposed.

bounded_prior_art.title: Back in Style: A Sociolinguistic Approach to Authoring and Measuring Persona Fidelity in User Simulation
bounded_prior_art.publication_note: The arXiv comment reports UserSim at NeurIPS 2026 acceptance. No official acceptance list or formal proceedings were checked; do not count a second publication.
bounded_prior_art.review_scope: Methods sections 3.1-3.4, results, discussion and limitations; no local reproduction.
bounded_prior_art.verified_findings: Hand-authored personas specify eight stylistic rate targets; deterministic adherence and character-ngram distinguishability are evaluated in customer-service simulation. Reported length correlations across five agents coexist with a fixed-character truncation check that preserves the schema advantage. These are not equivalent claims. Authors acknowledge that marker compliance does not ensure naturalness, semantic appropriateness or task success.
bounded_prior_art.implication: Style-rate prompting, deterministic feature adherence and length controls are prior art, not a new PersonaSLM algorithm. A real-speaker Japanese specificity study must distinguish targeted feature compliance from independent fidelity and semantic reliability.
bounded_prior_art.novelty_of_discovery: Previously monitored work; targeted methodological reinspection, not a new paper discovered today.

bounded_prior_art.title: Catch Me If You Can? Not Yet: LLMs Still Struggle to Imitate the Implicit Writing Styles of Everyday Authors
bounded_prior_art.review_scope: Methods section 3, ablations section 6, conclusion and limitations; no local reproduction.
bounded_prior_art.verified_findings: The four-dataset English study distinguishes authorship attribution, verification, style-model accuracy and automatic human-likeness detection. Selecting examples by target length produces mixed metric changes rather than uniform fidelity gains. Their length/content selection uses target information, and another condition supplies an initial target snippet. These settings are not leakage-free prospective dialogue continuation baselines for PersonaSLM. Large-scale human evaluation is absent.
bounded_prior_art.implication: Use only conditioning-side information to construct length controls. Report multiple applicable proxies separately; do not convert an attribution gain into semantic fidelity. Length alignment is an established baseline.
bounded_prior_art.novelty_of_discovery: Relevant prior publication reverified today; no claim of newly published work or a newly established version transition.

bounded_prior_art.title: Can Authorship Representation Learning Capture Stylistic Features?
bounded_prior_art.review_scope: Introduction, representation setup, content-word masking and cross-task style/topic probes; no local reproduction.
bounded_prior_art.verified_findings: Authorship success alone does not establish stylistic representation. The authors use content-word masking, paraphrasing and style-versus-topic transfer probes; their results support stylistic sensitivity for the studied representations without proving complete style/content separation.
bounded_prior_art.implication: A speaker-margin result is insufficient construct validation. Length/topic/mismatched-speaker controls have a clear rationale, but this paper does not validate PersonaSLM's handcrafted metric or Japanese short-turn use.
bounded_prior_art.novelty_of_discovery: Older primary methodological evidence, not new publication.
